notes: Curve construction (window, monotone repair, ECR level weight) and the base form were SELECTED PER POSITION by forward-chaining inner cross-validation on pinball loss; the training set is seasons strictly before 2026. Ridge for the mean with alpha by season-grouped CV; p10/p50/p90 by pinball-loss linear quantile regression over ranks 1-60 with rank in the design. K and DST are intercept-only by MEASUREMENT, not omission (nested CV: K -0.0073, DST -0.0041). SERVED HEADS (D16): gradient-boosted ensembles (HistGradientBoosting, depth 3, 300 rounds) on the same design for QB, RB, WR, TE; the linear heads remain for K/DST and as the --learner ridge floor.
